keys.label: Company number, validated (SIRET in France, NPI in the US)
keys.role: Identity of a site. Same validated number + same type = automatic merge

keys.label: Booking-calendar URL
keys.role: One calendar per site. Automatic merge only if a second key agrees

keys.label: Legal entity (SIREN in France)
keys.role: Links sites to one legal entity. Merges only with same name + postcode

keys.label: Normalised name + postcode
keys.role: Strong hint: manual review, never automatic alone

keys.label: Normalised phone
keys.role: Supporting evidence only: switchboards are shared

keys.label: Website domain (platforms and webmail excluded)
keys.role: Supporting evidence only: group domains are shared

guards.rule: Different validated company numbers are never merged
guards.why: Two sites, even under one legal entity, are two deployments

guards.rule: A site and a group are never merged
guards.why: It is a missing hierarchy link or the group's head-office site
A merge moves invoices and ARR: a human signs it off

guards.rule: Two owners with open deals: manual
guards.why: Ownership is a sales decision, not a data one

guards.rule: Shared phone, domain or name alone: no merge
guards.why: Groups share switchboards and domains; names repeat
The model cannot place the record
